packageRules.description: [group] Update the orchestrator-core package (incl. the mcp extra) and the ghcr.io/workfloworchestrator/orchestrator-core image together: docker-compose.yml mounts this repo's pyproject.toml and uv.lock into the image, and running 'db upgrade heads' with an image that differs from the pinned package leaves alembic revisions the other version cannot resolve. The group is always proposed and always manual: a dashboard approval would postpone the image entry until the package entry is approved separately, which is exactly the drift this rule prevents. After a group PR opens, check that its package version and its image tag are the same version

[cooldown] GHCR supplies no releaseTimestamp, so with the shared 3-day minimumReleaseAge and internalChecksFilter=strict the image's tag updates stay pending forever and are dropped from this mixed package+image group. Skip the age check for the orchestrator-core image only, so its tag updates join the group; the package keeps the shared release age

[disable] Only patch updates for the python Docker image (docker/lso/Dockerfile): it, requires-python and the orchestrator-core image stay on one Python version (currently 3.13), and docker versioning does not support version ranges, so a regex that accepts 3.13 patches only is the way to disable major/minor bumps
